testsuite.name: com.certverify.contracts.CertificateContractTests

testcase.name: issuance must be signed by the university
issuance must not consume a certificate
document hash must be a SHA-256 hex digest
cannot issue an already revoked certificate
certificate id must match the linear external id
revocation must be signed by the issuing university
cannot revoke an already revoked certificate
